transcript.en: Hi, can I help you?
transcript.zh: 你好，需要帮忙吗？

transcript.en: I was told to come here, because I'd like to talk to someone about taking a management course.
transcript.zh: 有人告诉我来这里，因为我想咨询关于管理课的事。

transcript.en: Right. I'm one of the tutors, so I should be able to help you.
transcript.zh: 是的，我是其中一位老师，所以我可以帮你。

transcript.en: Oh, good.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: My name's Brian Ardley.
transcript.zh: 我叫Brian Ardley。

transcript.en: I've decided to enroll on a part-time management course.
transcript.zh: 我想参加在职管理课程。

transcript.en: A friend of mine took one last year, and recommended it to me.
transcript.zh: 我的一个朋友去年参加了这个课程并推荐给我。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Is there anything I should do before the course, like reading or anything?
transcript.zh: 课之前我有什么要做的吗，比如阅读或其他之类的？

transcript.en: We prefer to integrate reading with the course, so we don't give out a reading list in advance.
transcript.zh: 我们更喜欢将阅读和课程结合在一起，所以我们不提前发放阅读书目。

transcript.en: But we like people to write a case study, describing an organisation they know.
transcript.zh: 但是我们希望同学写案例，描述一个他们了解的组织。

transcript.en: I've already done that, as my friends told me you wanted one.
transcript.zh: 我已经写了，我的朋友说过你们需要这个。

transcript.en: But would it be possible to sit in on a teaching session, to see what it's like?
transcript.zh: 但是可以让我去教学课试听看看吗？

transcript.en: I haven't been a student for quite a while.
transcript.zh: 我不当学生很久了。

transcript.en: Fine.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Just let me know which date, and I'll arrange it with the tutor.
transcript.zh: 告诉我合适的时间，我会为你安排老师。

transcript.en: Now, could I ask you about the college facilities, please?
transcript.zh: 现在我能问一下学校的设施怎么样吗？

transcript.en: Anything in particular?
transcript.zh: 具体想问什么？

transcript.en: Well, the course is one day a week, all day, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 一周有一天的课程，是全天的吧？

transcript.en: So presumably it's possible to buy food?
transcript.zh: 那么应该有地方吃饭吧？

transcript.en: Yes, the refectory's open all day.
transcript.zh: 是的，食堂全天开放。

transcript.en: Does it cater for special diets?
transcript.zh: 能满足特殊的饮食要求吗？

transcript.en: I have some food allergies.
transcript.zh: 我对一些食物过敏。

transcript.en: Provided you warn the refectory in advance, it won't be a problem.
transcript.zh: 我们会提前通知餐厅人员的，所以不用担心。

transcript.en: Good.
transcript.zh: 好。

transcript.en: What about facilities for young children?
transcript.zh: 小孩用的设施呢？

transcript.en: I'd like to bring my daughter here while I'm studying.
transcript.zh: 我想在我上课的时候把我的女儿带来。

transcript.en: How old is she?
transcript.zh: 她多大？

transcript.en: Three.
transcript.zh: 三岁。

transcript.en: Then she's eligible to join the nursery, which is supervised by a qualified Nursery Nurse.
transcript.zh: 她可以去育儿室，由合格的保育员负责看护。

transcript.en: The waiting list for a place is quite long though, so you ought to apply now.
transcript.zh: 候补名单上的人很多，所以你现在就该申请了。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: I don't know if our careers advice service would be of any interest to you?
transcript.zh: 我不知道你对我们的职业咨询服务感兴趣吗？

transcript.en: Yes, it might help me decide how to develop my career after the course.
transcript.zh: 是的。它也许能帮我在结课后决定如何发展我的事业。

transcript.en: The centre has a lot of reference materials and staff qualified to give guidance on a one-to-one basis.
transcript.zh: 中心有很多参考资料而且员工也能会为你提供一对一的指导。

transcript.en: I noticed a fitness centre next to the college.
transcript.zh: 我注意到大学旁边有一个健身中心，

transcript.en: Is that for students?
transcript.zh: 是为学生准备的吗？

transcript.en: It's open to everyone, but students pay an annual fee that's much less than the general public pay.
transcript.zh: 那里对每一个人开放，但是学生付的年费要比大众付的钱少很多。

transcript.en: And presumably the college library stocks newspapers and journals, as well as books?
transcript.zh: 大学图书馆里应该不但存有很多书，还有报纸、杂志？

transcript.en: Yes, and there's also an audio-visual room, for viewing and listening to videos, cassettes, and so on.
transcript.zh: 是的，这里还有视听教室供大家看视频、听磁带等等。

transcript.en: Is there also access to computers?
transcript.zh: 在这里可以用电脑吗？

transcript.en: Yes, your tutor will need to arrange with the technical support team for you to get a password, so ask him or her about it when you start the course.
transcript.zh: 是的，你的老师会安排技术支持组帮你拿到密码，所以在你开课的时候咨询他/她。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: By the way, do you know about our Business Centre?
transcript.zh: 对了，你知道我们的商务中心吗？

transcript.en: No.
transcript.zh: 不知道。

transcript.en: What's that?
transcript.zh: 那是什么？

transcript.en: It's a training resource—a collection of materials for people to study on their own, or use in their own organisations.
transcript.zh: 它是培训资源，帮助学生自学或用在他们自己的公司上的资料。

transcript.en: Uhuh.
transcript.zh: 哦

transcript.en: You mean books and videos?
transcript.zh: 你是说书和视频？

transcript.en: Yes and manuals for self-study.
transcript.zh: 是的，还有自学手册。

transcript.en: Plus a lot of computer-based materials, so people can work through them at their own speed, and repeat anything they aren't sure about.
transcript.zh: 另外还有很多计算机基础教材，所以人们可以根据自己的速度学习并且在不懂得地方反复地看。

transcript.en: And you can hire laptops to use in your own home or workplace as well as printers that you can take away.
transcript.zh: 你可以租一个笔记本回家用或在办公室用，还可以带走一台打印机。

transcript.en: Does it have anything that I could use to improve my study skills?
transcript.zh: 有什么可以帮我提高学习技巧的吗？

transcript.en: I don't have much idea about report writing, and I'm sure I'll need it on the course.
transcript.zh: 我对撰写报告不太了解，我肯定在课堂上会用到它。

transcript.en: Oh yes, there's plenty of useful material.
transcript.zh: 是的，这方面有很多资料。

transcript.en: Just ask one of the staff.
transcript.zh: 问下工作人员就行。

transcript.en: Does the centre cover all the main areas of business?
transcript.zh: 中心覆盖商业的主要领域吗？

transcript.en: Yes, topics like finance, and of course marketing that's a popular one.
transcript.zh: 是的，像金融，还有市场营销都是比较火的类别

transcript.en: Local managers seem to queue up to borrow the videos!
transcript.zh: 本地的管理者好像已经排队借阅录像了！

transcript.en: So it isn't just for students, then?
transcript.zh: 那么，这不只是为学生准备的？

transcript.en: No, it's for members only, but anyone can join.
transcript.zh: 不，只为会员提供，但是任何人都可以加入。

transcript.en: How much does it cost?
transcript.zh: 这要花多少钱？

transcript.en: ￡100 a year for a company, and ￡50 for an individual - with no discount for students, I'm afraid.
transcript.zh: 公司每年100英镑，个人是50英镑，恐怕对学生没有折扣。

transcript.en: That's very helpful.
transcript.zh: 这很有帮助。

transcript.en: Well, I think that's all.
transcript.zh: 我想就是这样了。

transcript.en: I'd better go home and fill in the enrollment form.
transcript.zh: 我最好回家去填报名表了。

transcript.en: Thanks for all your help.
transcript.zh: 谢谢你的帮助。

transcript.en: You're welcome.
transcript.zh: 不客气。

transcript.en: Goodbye.
transcript.zh: 再见。

transcript.en: Goodbye.
transcript.zh: 再见。
